newsitem.title: USA: Yahoo! tops Wall Street estimates.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo! tops Wall Street estimates.

text.p: Yahoo! Inc on Wednesday reported first quarter earnings that topped Wall Street estimates and said its traffic surged to an average of more than 30 million page views a day in March.

This was up 50 percent from the 20 million page views a day Yahoo! reported in December, 1996. Yahoo! reported net income of $210,000, or one cent a share, in the first quarter, up from net income of $81,000 in the year-earlier quarter.
Revenues soared to $9.5 million, more than $1 million above Wall Street estimates and up from $1.7 million in the first quarter of 1996. Yahoo! went public a year ago.
